surface: table-browser (src/browser/TableBrowser.tsx, src/browser/StructureTab.tsx, src/browser/browser.css, src/stores/browser.ts + browse-mode paths in grid/Grid.tsx, grid/ResultsPane.tsx, stores/results.ts, stores/tabs.ts)
works: Per-tab browse state (filters/sort/limit/draft) keyed byTab, mirrored to active tab; survives tab switches
Multi-filter builder: enable checkbox, AND/OR conjunction chain, 11 ops incl. IN / IS NULL / IS NOT NULL; correct identifier ('""') and literal ('') escaping — injection-safe
Fuzzy-searchable sort popover with PK+time quick group, click-to-flip direction, clear-sort, Enter picks first match
Infinite scroll via nearEndHook: grows LIMIT by 1000 when grid nears bottom, guarded on running + page-full
Data/Structure toggle; Structure shows columns (attnum/type/nullable/default/PK badge), FKs both directions, index defs; text is selectable
Inline draft row: sticky band under header, per-cell NULL toggle, untouched-column→DB DEFAULT semantics, cmd-Enter insert / Esc cancel, server error surfaced inline
ctid auto-added to SELECT for PK-less ordinary tables so rows stay editable/deletable
Open-or-focus dedupe of table tabs; views/matviews correctly get no Add-row
Refresh button with spinner; close routes through closeGuard (uncommitted-edit prompt)
Insert runs on the same tab session as the browse query (transaction-coherent), reloads after commit

gaps.title: Scrolling, filtering, or refreshing silently discards staged cell edits
gaps.detail: results.ts:185 — every run() calls useEdits.resetTab(tabId). browser.ts loadMore (196), setFilters (186), setSort (191), and refresh (206) all re-run the browse SQL. So: stage edits in the browse grid, scroll near the bottom → loadMore fires → all pending edits vanish with zero warning. Direct 'never lose work' violation, and it's triggered by mere scrolling. Fix: block/park loadMore while edits.pending is non-empty (or rebase edits keyed by PK values instead of rowIdx); prompt via closeGuard-style modal on explicit filter/sort/refresh when edits exist (TablePlus warns).

gaps.title: Mixed AND/OR filters return wrong rows: UI implies left-to-right chaining, SQL applies precedence
gaps.detail: browser.ts:113-117 — each condition is individually parenthesized then joined with the row's conj, so 'A OR B AND C' compiles to A OR (B AND C) while the linear UI reads ((A OR B) AND C). User builds 3 filters, silently gets a different result set. Fix: nest left-associatively — fold conditions as ((A) OR (B)) AND (C) — one-line change in the reduce; or add explicit group parens UI.

gaps.title: Filter value input fires a full streaming SELECT per keystroke [known]
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:137 onChange → update() → setFilters (browser.ts:186) → run(). Typing 'orders' = 6 queries against the server, each resetting edits and re-streaming up to LIMIT rows. Also fires on every column/op dropdown change mid-configuration (TableBrowser.tsx:115,123) — picking a column before typing a value still reruns the unfiltered SELECT. Fix: apply on Enter/blur (Enter handler already exists at :138) + explicit debounce; only auto-run on structural changes that are complete.

gaps.title: Infinite scroll is O(n²) re-fetch and dups/drops rows without a unique sort [known]
gaps.detail: browser.ts:196-204 + :122 — loadMore re-runs SELECT ... LIMIT n+1000 from row 0 every page (page 50 of a 1M-row table re-streams 50k rows), and with no ORDER BY (or a non-unique sort column, no PK tiebreaker) Postgres may return a different row order per execution → duplicated/missing rows across page boundaries: the grid lies. Fix: keyset pagination (WHERE (sortcol, pk) > (:last, :lastpk) ORDER BY sortcol, pk) appending rows; always add PK/ctid tiebreaker to ORDER BY.

gaps.title: Status bar implies the loaded page is the whole table
gaps.detail: ResultsPane.tsx:70-75 — a browse of a 5M-row table shows '1,000 rows' (capped flag only covers the backend 50k cap, never the browse LIMIT). Daily user reads it as the table's total. Fix: browser knows limit — show 'first 1,000 rows · ~5.2M total' using reltuples estimate from introspection (pairs with the [known] v0.4 table-size/row-estimate item), and 'all N rows' when rows.length < limit.

gaps.title: No way to cancel a running browse query from a table tab
gaps.detail: cmd-. cancel lives only in the SqlEditor keymap (SqlEditor.tsx:65) and QueryBox button — neither is mounted in a table tab. The refresh button is disabled while running (TableBrowser.tsx:55). Sort a 1M-row table on an unindexed column → the tab is stuck until the server finishes; no statement_timeout either yet. Fix: turn the refresh button into a Stop button while running (useResults.cancel is already in the store) + register cmd-. globally in App.tsx.

gaps.title: Draft row double-commit: cmd-Enter twice inserts the row twice
gaps.detail: browser.ts:230-252 commitDraft has no in-flight guard; draftRow stays set until the await resolves, so a second cmd-Enter (or Add-row button interplay) during the insert round-trip fires a second identical INSERT → duplicate row in the DB. Fix: committing flag in BrowseTab (set before await, cleared in finally); disable the draft band while committing.

gaps.title: Impossible to insert an empty string via draft row; cleared cell silently becomes DEFAULT
gaps.detail: browser.ts:244 — commitDraft only includes a column when cell.text !== '' (or isNull). Typing then clearing a cell reverts it to DEFAULT/omitted with no state change visible beyond the placeholder; '' can never be inserted. Fix: track touched-ness explicitly (cell exists in draftRow = touched → send '' as empty string); add a per-cell 'default' reset affordance next to the ∅ toggle so all three states (DEFAULT / NULL / '') are expressible and visible.

gaps.title: Table tab silently re-runs against a different connection after profile switch
gaps.detail: browser.ts run() → results.run uses the *current* activeProfileId to ensureTabSession. A table tab opened on profile A, after switching the rail to profile B, will refresh/loadMore against B's database — wrong data or a confusing 'relation does not exist'. openTable dedupe (browser.ts:165-171) also matches schema+name across profiles, focusing the wrong profile's tab. Fix: stamp profileId on the table Tab; refuse/deactivate browse actions when activeProfileId differs; dedupe by (profileId, schema, name).

gaps.title: Stale TableInfo after DDL: filters, sort, draft row and Structure show the columns from tab-open time
gaps.detail: tabs.ts:96-111 stores a TableInfo snapshot on the Tab; nothing updates it when useSchema refetches (DDL sniff, cmd-R). ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN → data grid shows the new column (SELECT *) but the filter column dropdown, sort popover, draft band and Structure tab don't have it; dropped columns linger and generate erroring SQL. Fix: on schema snapshot update, re-resolve each table tab's TableInfo by (schema, name) via a subscribe in browser.ts (or resolve table lazily from the snapshot instead of storing it).

gaps.title: Filter operator set is thin: no NOT IN / NOT LIKE / BETWEEN / regex / contains shortcuts / IS TRUE-FALSE / jsonb-array ops
gaps.detail: browser.ts:20-22 FILTER_OPS. Table-stakes vs TablePlus: NOT IN, NOT LIKE/ILIKE, BETWEEN, ~ / ~*, 'contains / starts with / ends with' (auto-wrap %…% so users needn't type wildcards), IS TRUE/IS FALSE for bools, IS DISTINCT FROM, @> for jsonb/arrays, ANY(=) for arrays. Fix: extend FilterOp union + browseSql compile arms; group ops in the select by relevance.

gaps.title: Filters are type-blind: operators and value inputs ignore column type
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:122-140 — ILIKE offered on integer columns (server error), no bool dropdown, no enum value list, no date input, everything quoted as a text literal (browser.ts:110 works via implicit cast but LIKE on non-text just errors). Fix: TableInfo.columns has type/type_oid — filter the op list per type class and swap the value editor (bool select, date input, enum options); optionally a distinct-values picker (SELECT DISTINCT col LIMIT 50).

gaps.title: Filter column picker is a raw <select>: unusable on wide tables, no search
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:115-121 — a 300-column table gives a native 300-option dropdown, while the sort popover right next to it already has fuzzy search. Fix: reuse the SortSelect fuzzy-popover pattern (or a shared searchable-combobox primitive) for the filter column field.

gaps.title: No raw-WHERE escape hatch and no way to see/copy the generated SQL
gaps.detail: The browse SQL (browser.ts:94-123) is invisible to the user — violates SQL-first/'never lies' spirit: you can't verify what WHERE was built (especially given the precedence bug), can't copy it, can't 'open as query tab' to go beyond the builder, and there's no raw-WHERE input mode like TablePlus's. Fix: 'Open in SQL editor' + 'Copy query' actions in the header/filter bar; a raw-WHERE mode toggle on the filter bar.

gaps.title: No header-click sort, no sort indicator in the grid, single-column sort only
gaps.detail: Grid.tsx:479 — clicking a column header starts a column drag-select; in browser mode it should sort server-side (toggle ASC→DESC→clear), with an arrow glyph in the header cell. Sort state is only visible in the small popover button (TableBrowser.tsx:238). Multi-column sort (shift-click) missing entirely; browser.ts:46 sort is a single {col,dir}. [known: v0.4 lists click-header sort for query results; the browser needs the server-side variant]

gaps.title: Zero keyboard shortcuts on the whole surface
gaps.detail: App.tsx:107-167 has no browser bindings: no refresh-data key (cmd-R is schema refresh), no Data↔Structure toggle (cmd-1/2 or ctrl-tab-like), no focus-filter-bar (cmd-F once find lands should coexist), no add-filter, no add-row (cmd-N in TablePlus), no cancel (cmd-.), Esc doesn't clear/blur a filter input. 'Keyboard-first' ideology — this surface is 100% mouse today. Fix: a small browser-scoped key handler in TableBrowser + entries in the keyboard map.

gaps.title: Column widths reset on every refresh/filter/sort/page and on Data↔Structure toggle
gaps.detail: Grid.tsx:124-133 — widthsInitialized resets whenever statement.columns changes identity, and every browse re-run produces a fresh statements array; toggling to Structure unmounts the Grid entirely. Hand-resized widths are lost multiple times a minute during normal browsing. Fix: key widths by (schema.table, column-name list) in a small store/appdb map [known: v0.5 persist-column-widths is the durable half; the in-session reset is fixable now by keying on column names not array identity].

gaps.title: Draft-row autoFocus steals focus back to the first column when horizontal scroll remounts it
gaps.detail: Grid.tsx:543 — autoFocus={vc.index === firstDraftCol} on a *virtualized* cell: scroll right to fill later columns of a wide table, the first draft cell unmounts; scroll back (or any remount) → autoFocus fires again and yanks focus mid-typing. Fix: focus once imperatively on draft open (ref + effect keyed on showDraft), never via autoFocus on virtual items.

gaps.title: Partitioned tables (kind 'p') get no Add-row and no ctid fallback consideration
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:89 canInsert = kind === 'r' — but partitioned parents are routinely INSERTed into in PG; they're excluded. (Foreign tables 'f' are also often writable.) browser.ts:121 similarly only 'r' gets ctid. Fix: allow insert for kinds r+p (and f), keep ctid restricted to 'r' (ctid is not unique across partitions — correctly excluded).

gaps.title: Every filter keystroke / scroll page writes browse SQL into query history
gaps.detail: results.ts:277-284 history_add runs for browser-generated queries too — typing a 6-char filter value logs 6 SELECTs; an afternoon of browsing floods history/sqlite and buries real queries (compounds the [known] unbounded-history bug). Fix: pass a source flag through run() and skip (or tag) history for browser-originated SQL.

gaps.title: Structure tab is ~20% of table-stakes depth: no constraints, triggers, partitions, comments, DDL, size
gaps.detail: StructureTab.tsx renders columns/FKs/indexes only. Missing vs TablePlus/DataGrip: UNIQUE/CHECK/EXCLUSION constraints, triggers, partition list + partition key, table/column comments, view/matview definition SQL (a view's Structure shows columns with no source — glaring), identity/generated-column info, FK ON DELETE/ON UPDATE actions, table size + row estimate, owner, RLS policies. Fix: extend introspection (or lazy per-table queries) + sections; DDL pane rides the [known] v0.4 get_ddl backend.

gaps.title: No jump-to-row / go-to-end / page controls — the tail of a big table is unreachable
gaps.detail: Only forward infinite scroll exists (browser.ts:196). Seeing the last rows of a 1M-row table means loading 1000 pages at O(n²) cost; no 'jump to row N', no last-page, no page-size control. Fix: with keyset pagination, add 'jump to end' (flip sort + fetch) and a go-to-offset field; meta-ArrowDown currently only jumps within loaded rows (Grid.tsx:297).

gaps.title: No duplicate-row action [known]
gaps.detail: Row context menu (Grid.tsx:633-674) has Copy/Set NULL/Set EMPTY/Delete only. 'Duplicate row (minus PK, opens as draft for tweak-then-insert)' is a daily TablePlus flow; insertRow + draftRow machinery already exists in browser.ts — wire selection row values into beginDraft. [known: v0.45]

gaps.title: No context menus on browser chrome: title, filter rows, structure rows, sort button [known]
gaps.detail: tb-title has no right-click (Copy name / Copy schema.name / Copy SELECT / Open in editor); Structure rows have no Copy column name / Copy type / Copy DDL / follow-FK; filter rows have no duplicate-filter/move. The grid cell menu also lacks 'Filter by this value' which is *the* browse affordance. [known: context-menu epic covers most — filter-row menu and 'Filter by value' wiring into useBrowser.setFilters are browser-specific work]

gaps.title: No export from the browser [known]
gaps.detail: No 'Export table / current filter result to CSV/JSON/SQL' anywhere on the surface (header or context menu). [known: v0.4 export lands the engine; browser needs the entry point that exports the *filtered* set via the generated WHERE]

gaps.title: Refresh button on Structure tab reruns the data query instead of re-introspecting
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:51-58 — refresh always calls browser.refresh() (data SQL); on the Structure tab the visible content (snapshot-derived columns/FKs/indexes) doesn't change, so the button appears dead while silently burning a query. Fix: when tab==='structure', trigger useSchema.fetch for the active profile instead.

gaps.title: IN value parsing: naive comma split
gaps.detail: browser.ts:107 — values containing commas can't be expressed (no quoting), trailing comma yields an empty-string member, no NULL member support, whitespace-only members become ''. Fix: CSV-quote-aware split ('a,"b,c"'), drop empty trailing tokens, document in placeholder.

gaps.title: Filter rows keyed by array index — remove/reorder reuses component state
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:97 key={i}: deleting filter 1 of 3 shifts state; controlled inputs mask most of it but focus/selection jump to the wrong row. Fix: stable id per filter (crypto.randomUUID on add).

gaps.title: Incomplete filter (empty value) is silently inactive while looking enabled
gaps.detail: browser.ts:101-102 — a filter with value='' is skipped from WHERE but its row still shows a checked checkbox; user believes 'col = <empty>' is filtering (and genuinely cannot express col = '' at all). Fix: dim/badge incomplete rows ('needs value'), and add an explicit empty-string token (e.g. '' literal or a ∅/empty toggle) so = '' is expressible.

gaps.title: Sort popover paper cuts: row click doesn't close, stale search text, no arrow-key navigation, no per-row ASC/DESC
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:216-233 pick() leaves the popover open (only Enter/backdrop close); query state persists across open/close (stale search on reopen — clear on open); no ArrowUp/Down + Enter through the list; choosing DESC requires two clicks. Fix: close on pick, reset query on open, roving keyboard focus, small asc/desc affordance per row.

gaps.title: Empty result set renders a blank grid with no explanation
gaps.detail: ResultsPane.tsx:59-65 — 0 rows with columns → headers over void; no 'No rows match your 2 filters — clear filters' vs 'Table is empty — add a row' distinction/CTA. Fix: empty-state overlay in browse mode aware of active filter count (useBrowser.filters).

gaps.title: Browse SQL errors point at positions in SQL the user never wrote
gaps.detail: A bad filter (e.g. LIKE on int, bad date literal) surfaces the raw PG error with a character position into the generated SELECT (ResultsPane.tsx:51-58). Fix: in browse mode, map the failing condition back to its filter row (mark it red) and show the generated SQL alongside.

gaps.title: Grid scroll position leaks across table tabs and dies on Data↔Structure toggle
gaps.detail: browser.ts:61 comment claims per-tab 'scroll' but nothing stores it: switching tab A→B keeps A's scrollTop on B's data (same mounted Grid), and Data→Structure→Data resets to top (Grid unmounts). Fix: store scrollTop in BrowseTab, restore on activate; keep Grid mounted (hidden) or restore imperatively.

gaps.title: Inserted row invisible after commit — no locate/scroll-to or 'hidden by filter' notice
gaps.detail: browser.ts:216 run() reloads; with a sort or filters the new row often isn't in the loaded window. TablePlus highlights/scrolls to the new row. Fix: after insert, RETURNING pk → find row in reloaded set → scroll+flash; else toast 'inserted (outside current filter/sort window)'.

gaps.title: FK section: directions mixed, no schema qualification, not navigable
gaps.detail: StructureTab.tsx:11-16 merges outgoing and incoming FKs into one unlabeled list rendered src→dst; on self-referencing or cross-schema FKs you can't tell which side this table is, and rows aren't clickable to open the referenced table (openTable exists). Fix: two subsections ('References' / 'Referenced by'), schema-qualify foreign side, click→openTable.

gaps.title: Draft-row ∅ buttons sit in the Tab order between inputs
gaps.detail: Grid.tsx:549-556 — tabbing across draft cells hits input, ∅, input, ∅…; slows the type-Tab-type-Tab insert flow. Fix: tabIndex={-1} on the null toggles (keyboard NULL already exists as a pattern via cmd-shift-Backspace in CellEditor — mirror it here).

gaps.title: No table-kind badge or read-only explanation in the header
gaps.detail: TableBrowser.tsx:36-39 — a view, matview, or foreign table looks identical to a table; the only tell is the missing Add-row button. 'Direct manipulation: read-only cells say why' — the surface should say 'view (read-only)' up front. Fix: kind chip next to tb-title from table.kind.

gaps.title: No last-refreshed indicator or auto-refresh interval
gaps.detail: After an hour in a tab the data is silently stale; TablePlus shows reload affordances and DataGrip offers auto-refresh (5s/30s/1m) for monitoring workflows. Fix: 'refreshed 4m ago' next to the refresh button + optional interval menu on long-press/right-click of refresh.

gaps.title: loadMore double-fire race and boundary waste
gaps.detail: Grid.tsx:437-445 unthrottled onScroll can call nearEndHook twice before results.running flips true → limit jumps 2 pages (browser.ts:196-204 guard reads stale running). Also when rowcount is an exact multiple of 1000, one extra full re-query returns the identical set before growth stops. Fix: in-flight flag in loadMore itself; compare returned rows < limit after each load.

gaps.title: Unbounded LIMIT growth vs the 50k in-memory cap
gaps.detail: browser.ts:202 limit grows forever (51k, 52k…) while the frontend/backend cap sits at 50k — past the cap each scroll-triggered re-run re-streams 50k rows to add nothing visible (capped flag set), i.e., an expensive no-op loop at the bottom of big tables. Fix: stop growing at the cap and show 'loaded 50k of ~N — refine filters or export' (dissolves with keyset pagination).

perf_risks: Full streaming SELECT per keystroke in filter value input, plus one per col/op dropdown change (browser.ts:186 setFilters→run; TableBrowser.tsx:115-140) — network+server round-trip per char, each also resetting edits and refetching the editability map

Infinite scroll re-streams rows 0..N every page (browser.ts:196-204): O(n²) total rows transferred; page 500 of a 1M-row table re-decodes 500k rows; refresh() at a grown limit re-fetches the entire loaded window in one query
Unbounded in-memory row growth: limit += 1000 forever with no tie-in to the 50k cap; a bottom-scroll on a huge table pins memory and makes every subsequent re-run maximally expensive
Unthrottled grid onScroll near-end check (Grid.tsx:437-445) + stale-running race → duplicate loadMore growth in one frame
Every browse re-run triggers ensureMap (editability introspection IPC) and a history_add sqlite write (results.ts:169-284) — per keystroke when combined with the filter-input issue
estimateWidths + full widths-state reset on every new statements array (Grid.tsx:124-133) → whole-grid re-layout on each page/filter/sort/refresh
StructureTab filters the whole snapshot's foreign_keys and indexes arrays on every render with no memo (StructureTab.tsx:11-20) — O(all-indexes) per render; noticeable on 10k+-object schemas
Grid cells unmemoized (rows×cols re-render on any selection/store change) — [known, grid surface] but amplified in browser mode by 500-column SELECT * tables
FilterBar re-renders every filter row per keystroke (fine at n<10, but rebuilds the full 300-option column <select> per row per char on wide tables)
